DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY

LC Industries Inc.,** Durham, North Carolina (SPE8EN-27-D-0001); Envision Xpress Inc.,** Wichita, Kansas (SPE8EN-27-D-0002); Alabama Institute for Deaf & Blind,** Talladega, Alabama (SPE8EN-27-D-0003); Blind Industries & Services of Maryland,** Baltimore, Maryland (SPE8EN-27-D-0004); San Antonio Lighthouse for the Blind,** San Antonio, Texas (SPE8EN-27-D-0005); The Lighthouse for the Blind Inc.,** Seattle Washington (SPE8EN-27-D-0006); South Texas Lighthouse for the Blind Foundation,** Corpus Christi, Texas (SPE8EN-27-D-0007); Virginia Department for The Blind and Vision Impaired,** Charlottesville, Virginia (SPE8EN-27-D-0008); Industries for the Blind and Visually Impaired Inc.,** West Allis, Wisconsin (SPE8EN-27-D-0009); Central Association for the Blind Inc.,** Utica, New York (SPE8EN-27-D-0010); Beyond Vision - AIB Inc.,** West Allis, Wisconsin (SPE8EN-27-D-0011); and Winston-Salem Industries for the Blind Inc.,** Winston Salem, North Carolina (SPE8EN-27-D-0012), are sharing a maximum $985,000,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract under solicitation SPE8EN-25-R-0004 with other suppliers for base supply center supplies. Other contracts are expected to be awarded under this solicitation, and awardees will compete for a portion of the maximum dollar value. These are five-year contracts with no option periods. The performance completion date is Nov. 12, 2031. Using customers are Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, and federal civilian agencies. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 through 2032 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

United Food Service Inc., doing business as Shamrock Foods Co., Aurora, Colorado, has been awarded a maximum $21,340,976 firm-fixed-price with economic-price-adjustment, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for full-line food and beverage items. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.103-1. This is a 336-day bridge contract with no option periods. Locations of performance are Colorado and Wyoming, with an Oct. 16, 2027, ordering period end date. Using military services are Army and Air Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 through 2028 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPE300-27-D-3003).

Wilcox Industries Corp., Newington, New Hampshire, has been awarded a maximum $17,821,302 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for Universal Helmet Mount Assembly for the Enhanced Night Vision Goggle III and Enhanced Night Vision Goggle Binocular systems. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1), as stated in the Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.103-1. This is a five-year contract with no option periods. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support, Aberdeen Proving Grounds, Maryland (SPRBL1-27-D-A002). (Awarded on Oct. 22, 2026.)

AIR FORCE

Northrop Grumman Systems Corp., Linthicum Heights, Maryland, has been awarded a $79,608,480 modification (P00191) to a previously awarded contract (FA8615-17-C-6047) for Active Electronically Scanned Array radars of Air Force F-16 aircraft. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $2,061,087,012 from $1,981,478,532. Work will be performed in Linthicum Heights, Maryland, and is expected to be completed Dec. 31, 2027. Fiscal 2027 procurement funds in the amount of $19,688,883; fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $2,843,160; fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $35,937,544; fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $11,372,640; and fiscal 2025 procurement funds in the amount of $9,766,253, are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

Northrop Grumman Systems Corp., San Diego, California, has been awarded a $19,978,104 modification (P00036) to previously awarded (FA8690-24-C-B001) for RQ-4 Global Hawk aircraft sustainment. This modification brings total cumulative face value of the contract to $613,381,512. Work will be performed in San Diego, California, and is expected to be completed by July 31, 2026. This modification involves Foreign Military Sales to the Republic of Korea and Japan Ministry of Defense. Foreign Military Sales funds in the amount of $19,978,104 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

NAVY

Raytheon Co., El Segundo, California, is awarded a $42,121,481 fixed-price incentive (firm-target) and cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00010) to a previously awarded contract (N0001925C0104) to incorporate the mid-band extended configuration into low-rate initial production Lot Five of the Next Generation Jammer Mid-Band program. The modification converts the existing production requirement to the mid-band extended configuration without increasing the existing Lot Five quantity. The effort includes manufacture, integration, test, delivery, associated spares, non-recurring engineering, production and test support, integrated logistics support, and technical data deliverables. Work will be performed in McKinney, Texas (65.7%); Forest, Mississippi (20.4%); El Segundo, California (13.4%); and Andover, Massachusetts (0.5%), and is expected to be completed in May 2029. Fiscal 2027 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $5,249,957; fiscal 2025 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $28,819,791; and foreign cooperative projects (Navy) funds in the amount of $8,051,732, will be obligated at the time of award. This contract modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY

Insignia Federal Group LLC,* McLean, Virginia, has been awarded a $12,455,347 modification (P00003) to exercise the first option period of a previously awarded firm-fixed-price contract (HT001126CE001) to provide management, administrative, and expert services supporting TRICARE Health Plan enterprise and executive offices responsible for directing the Military Health System health plan and managing purchased health care services, programs, and acquisitions. The cumulative value of the contract, including the exercised option, is $35,299,647. The option period of performance is Oct. 9, 2026, through Oct. 8, 2027. No funds were obligated at the time of option exercise on Sept. 30, 2026; however, fiscal year 2027 operations and maintenance funds were subsequently obligated on Nov. 10, 2026. The Defense Health Agency, Medical Digital Solutions Contracting Division, Falls Church, Virginia, is the contracting activity.
